description: This file defines a custom PasswordType class for a Symfony form, which overrides the default password input to include additional options like 'pre_addon', 'post_addon', and 'row_class' for customization, and sets a custom block prefix.

classes.name: PasswordType
classes.description: A custom form type class extending Symfony's PasswordType, adding default options and a custom block prefix for rendering password fields with additional UI elements.

methods.name: getBlockPrefix
methods.description: Returns a custom block prefix 'custom_password' used in form templates.

methods.name: configureOptions
methods.description: Sets default options for the form type such as 'pre_addon', 'post_addon', and 'row_class'.

methods.name: getParent
methods.description: Specifies the parent form type as Symfony's PasswordType.

methods.name: buildView
methods.description: Modifies the form view variables to include custom options for rendering.
